Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer relied on a misleading search snippet that conflated two different artists (the British singer Gabrielle and the Norwegian singer from Bergen), surfacing “Bergen, Norway” as the birthplace alongside “Louisa Gabriella Bobb.” It did not click through to verify the article content or cross-check with reliable sources, introducing an incorrect birthplace when the correct one is Hackney, London, England.
